sections.title: The Valley of Elah: Setting and Regional Archaeology

blocks.text: The narrative precisely locates the confrontation: at Socoh and Azekah, with armies encamped in the Valley of Elah on opposite mountain slopes. These place names anchor the story in the southwestern Judean terrain where Israelite and Philistine territorial interests intersected during the early Iron Age. Archaeological investigation of the Elah Valley region has documented settlement patterns and conflict contexts consistent with the period, though such evidence illuminates the general regional world rather than verifying individual episodes.
